_scenario: RAIN-WEEK MOISTURE SET - client arbitration 2026-08-15 (rain-week moisture study). The stone is EXTREMELY POROUS (client): after 1 week of CONTINUOUS RAIN on the OUTDOOR stockpiles the moistures below apply, then drain slowly back to the 7 % reference over 5-7 days. Every moisture value is [H] (client porous-stone estimate) until the new external trigger fires: an ABSORPTION TEST ON SAMPLES. This file is DATA-FIRST: engine defaults in data/default_parameters.json are UNCHANGED (7 % measured 2026-08-08); the study composes photos from the override blocks below.
_operating_policy: Client 2026-08-15: the line CONTINUES EVERYWHERE during the rain week. Rain forces zone 1.2 into mode 2B - requalified the same day as PHYSICS, not policy: WET SCREENING AT 1.7 mm IS IMPOSSIBLE (blinding), so zero AgLime during rain; the zone-1.3 SC.B 2/1.5 cuts sit BEHIND the dryer at 0.5 % moisture and are UNAFFECTED; the 6 mm and 20/35 mm cuts remain feasible wet with the wet_capacity_factor derating.

stock_moistures_pct._basis: wet basis, same convention as feed_product.properties.moisture_pct; 7 % = the dry-reference measured value (belt cut 2026-08-08)

quarry_feed_after_rain_week.status: [H] client porous-stone estimate 2026-08-15 (7 -> 12 % after 1 week continuous rain, outdoor pile), pending the absorption test on samples

reclaimed_0_20_stock_after_rain_week.status: [H] client porous-stone estimate 2026-08-15 (7 -> 15 %; the finest outdoor pile absorbs the most), pending the absorption test on samples

feedlime_6_20_stock_after_rain_week.status: [H] client porous-stone estimate 2026-08-15 (7 -> 11 %; coarser 6/20 pile drains better), pending the absorption test on samples

drainage.status: [H] client 2026-08-15: slow drainage back to 7 % over 5-7 days after the rain stops; the study uses the 6-day midpoint with LINEAR interpolation of each stock moisture back to 7 % (day d of D: m_d = m_peak + (7 - m_peak) x d/D). Shape and duration to be replaced by the absorption/drainage test.

annual_rain_weeks.status: [H] FLAGGED STUDY CHOICE 2026-08-15: N rain weeks per year is PARAMETERIZED; 6 picked as the default pending site rainfall records (client to confirm). The annual view scales linearly in N.

external_trigger: ABSORPTION TEST ON SAMPLES = NEW EXTERNAL TRIGGER (client 2026-08-15): a laboratory absorption + drainage test on stockpile samples replaces the three [H] rain-week moistures and the [H] drainage profile above. Joins the existing external-trigger list (vendor curves, drop-weight, site Bond, sieve test, repeat belt-cuts, NACO reconciliation).
engine_limitation: The engine carries ONE GLOBAL moisture per photo (feed_product.properties.moisture_pct): in scenario.py the zone-1.2 reclaim and the zone-1.3 FeedLime streams INHERIT THE FEED moisture. Distinct simultaneous stock moistures (12/15/11) are NOT expressible in a single photo, so the study reads a COMPOSITE of per-zone photos, each run at its own stock moisture (blocks below). MODEL-IMPROVEMENT ITEM: per-stream moisture overrides (e.g. default_scenario.stream_moistures_pct.{reclaim,feedlime}).
